_game: Rush Hour (puzzle: slide cars to free the red car)
_note: Setup: (1) pip install 'git+https://github.com/chrplr/Rush-Hour.git#subdirectory=python'; (2) clone the repo to vendor/rush-hour-src and build the Go engine: `git clone https://github.com/chrplr/Rush-Hour vendor/rush-hour-src && cd vendor/rush-hour-src && go build -o rushhour-env ./cmd/rushhour-env` (the adapter auto-finds it there, or set RUSHHOUR_ENV_BIN / the phase 'binary'). Turn-based; number keys 1-9,0 = moves. Env ids: RushHour-v0, RushHour-Easy-v0, RushHourFixed-v0.
